verdict.rationale: Navan documents several natural-language surfaces of its own. Navan Edge lets users book flights, hotels, and restaurants by chatting, with explicit confirmation before acting. Ava answers spend questions in conversation. The hosted Navan MCP server lets AI assistants query spend and travel data in natural language. However, the MCP and Ava surfaces are documented mainly for querying and analysis, and Edge is positioned for the most frequent travelers, so full operation of the product by natural language is not shown. Missing for 10: documented natural-language actions across expense management (submitting or approving expenses, card actions), confirmation that Edge is broadly available beyond a premium tier, and independent or hands-on corroboration of any of these surfaces.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: You can book flights, hotels, and restaurant reservations by chatting with Navan Edge.
The Navan MCP lets you connect Navan to your favorite AI products, so you can query Navan spend and travel data using natural language.
Ava slices and dices real-time spend data, provides insights into T&E questions, and proactively finds opportunities for savings.
Reserved for the world's most frequent travelers
